name: Instability
overview: Scripture reveals instability as a condition marked by wavering resolve and moral failure, exemplified by Reuben's instability described as 'unstable as water' due to his sin against his father (Genesis 49:4). Pharaoh's repeated hardening of his heart despite witnessing God's power further illustrates spiritual instability, showing a refusal to yield to God's will even after clear signs and judgments (Exodus 8:15, 8:32, 9:34, 10:8). These examples underscore the consequences of instability in character and faith, highlighting the importance of steadfastness in honoring God.
